hero.title: Healthy gums first. A confident smile follows.
hero.lead: A periodontist-led clinic in Tadepalli with specialists for gum care, oral surgery and root canal treatment — so most problems can be looked after under one roof.

symptoms.title: What's troubling you?
symptoms.lead: Pick what you are feeling. We'll suggest the right doctor and open the booking for you.

treatments.title: Care for every part of your smile
treatments.lead: {{categoryCount}} treatment areas, each matched to the doctor best placed to help.

approach.title: Strong teeth need healthy foundations
approach.lead: Crowns, implants and fillings last longest when the gums and bone around them are healthy. That is why every plan here begins with a gum check.

points.title: Specialist-led
points.text: The clinic is headed by a periodontist, with an oral surgeon and a root canal specialist on the team.

points.title: Plain explanations
points.text: You see what we see, hear the options in simple words, and know the cost before treatment begins.

points.title: Careful hygiene
points.text: Instruments are sterilised and single-use items are used once, every time.

points.title: Evening sessions
points.text: Open {{hoursShort}}, so a visit can fit around work or college.

doctors.title: Meet the specialists
doctors.lead: {{doctorCount}} MDS specialists, each focused on one area of dental care.

booking.title: Book in a minute, get reminders automatically
booking.lead: Choose your concern, doctor and time online. Once booked, reminders reach you so you don't miss the visit.

steps.title: Choose doctor and time
steps.text: See the days and times available.

steps.title: Confirm with your mobile
steps.text: A one-time code verifies your number.

education.title: Read before you worry
education.lead: Short, practical guides written for patients.

visit.title: Find the clinic on Ashramam Road
visit.lead: We are on Ashramam Road in Tadepalli, a short drive from Undavalli, Mangalagiri and Vijayawada.

cta.title: Your gums will thank you.
cta.lead: Book a check-up today — it takes about a minute.
